name: whatsapp-group-bot
description: WhatsApp Group Bot with message counter, link blocker, auto-reply, and web admin dashboard

scripts.start: lsof -t -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; node src/server.js
scripts.dev: lsof -t -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; node --watch src/server.js
scripts.test: node tests/test_core.js && node tests/test_crash_logger.js && node tests/test_interactive_commands.js
